evidence.title: Hearing for Municipal Curative Amendment regarding Data Centers to be held on September 24, 2026 at 6:00 P.M.
evidence.supports: Confirms the Board of Supervisors' hearing on adoption of the 'Data Center Ordinance' (municipal curative amendment) is scheduled for 2026-09-24 -- one day after the 2026-09-23 reference date -- and that the pending Sentinel/Green Fig application is not on that meeting's agenda, exactly as the row's current_status already states.
evidence.quote: On September 24, 2026, the Board of Supervisors will hold a hearing to consider adoption of the Municipal Curative Amendment (a.k.a. the “Data Center Ordinance”)... Please note, the application of Sentinel, Green Fig is not on the agenda for this meeting.

decisions.notes: This row is not actually past its term as of the reference date: the 180-day municipal-curative-amendment clock and the resulting ordinance-adoption hearing are still pending, with the hearing occurring the day after 2026-09-23. Re-confirmed directly from the Township's own site with no change needed.
